literalLines.text: - Tests verify faithful extraction, staged integration, and regression safety. They do not justify substituting different shader algorithms merely because self-authored tests pass. Matched GPU images use the same original source, camera, viewport/DPR, samples, settings, and output encoding.

- Architecture or performance improvements to production require an observed problem, a focused justified change, and regression evidence. No speculative renderer replacement. The requested reload camera/grid corrections remain explicitly in scope.

1. **Display completeness:** reconcile divergent course rendering with the actual production shaders and pipelines; complete pending CAD evidence without restarting already valid builds; consolidate pen width/AA, marker/cloud display controls, original Plane, and relevant color rules into existing lessons. Diagnose the known fine stroke-end difference with a matched witness. Verify real BRep holes, legible NURBS isolines, mirrored/nonuniform placement, and family visibility independently.

3. **Reload behavior, after implementation coverage:** in maintained and course viewers, Session reload retains the latest camera pose, including user motion while loading. The shown base grid changes only after an explicit construction-plane command that actually changes its plane. Account for floating-origin coordinate rebasing when checking the world plane.

Freeze runtime source after the reload/grid correction. Run the complete required Native/WASM/build checks and declared runnable-checkpoint checks against that final state. Inspect actual feature evidence for every chapter, close the coverage table, verify navigation/aliases and local publication, and report the final counts and known limitations. Never relabel stale results as current.

The book teaches the complete viewer through a finite, coherent sequence; every required feature has a lesson and truthful evidence; remaining private drafts are either integrated or explicitly obsolete; runnable lessons and required checks pass; load/frame improvements have measurements; reload preserves camera and construction plane; and the local docs browser displays the final published book. No further chapter is created merely to close a validation gate.
